frontendRoot.description: Absolute path to the frontend project root. API-Agent will crawl src/services/metrics/ and component source files under this path.

backendRoot.description: Optional. Absolute path to the backend project root. When provided, API-Agent cross-references frontend transformResponse field names against backend row class field names and reports contract drift.

targetComponents.description: Component names or relative paths to trace. API-Agent locates each component under frontendRoot and follows its data dependencies.

apiBaseUrl.description: Optional. Live backend base URL (e.g. http://localhost:8080) for Susan's live validation steps. Does not affect source-based discovery.

apiToken.description: Optional. Bearer token to include in Susan's live validation step templates. Never logged or stored in output — only used to generate test request templates.
